classification: Actual bounded Gallery renderer regression and verification records. This is not complete Gallery ROUNDTRIP acceptance, full v1 parity, a viewer policy change, or a release approval.
scope: Gallery renderer grid image alternative text and figure accessible names only. Editor-derived alt, open Expose/native-dialog captions and full Gallery ROUNDTRIP remain open.
sourceRelationship: The two browser source files were identical in RED and GREEN. The only production delta was renderer/renderers/gallery/index.js. Main commits contain byte-for-byte copies of the reviewed, executed files; C11 manifests below retain their original isolated base-plus-diff identities and external dependency symlink.

No viewer policy or editor state/history mechanism changes.

observations.scopeDecision: Current repair changes only grid img.alt and figure aria-label. Open Expose/fallback viewer remains unchanged and outside acceptance; native viewer controls are required for a later repair.

peerReview.kind: Independent read-only review; reviewer did not rerun browser or unit gates.
peerReview.findings: No blockers in the bounded grid-label repair: all three createItem paths receive the existing owning-document inline parser, one derived textContent value serves alt and ARIA, and literal/widget/saved/iframe/cleanup controls are independent. Editor and open viewer paths remain outside the change.

remainingObligations: Gallery editor image alt still derives from canonical markup before hydrated widget labels; it needs its separately approved projection-completion contract.
Open Expose captions/slide alt and the owning-document native-dialog caption/alt remain unchanged; viewer interaction and navigation controls have not been run for this repair.
The complete Gallery ROUNDTRIP template, native caption edit and history, viewer controls and all layout actions are not accepted by these 150 assertions.
